new_today_news.headline: TerraCycle US Acquires NLR Inc. and Acquires Processing Facility in Connecticut
new_today_news.summary: TerraCycle US acquired NLR Inc. (a Universal Waste company) for $2.75 million and purchased the associated processing facility in East Windsor, Connecticut for $1.2 million. This is TerraCycle's fourth acquisition of a Universal Waste company.

recent_news.headline: For Food Waste/Biogas, Landia Takes the Long-Term Pump View with Hayley Dexis
recent_news.summary: Landia supplied new long-coupled Chopper Pumps for a food-waste-to-renewable-energy company, addressing specific engineering needs for biogas/AD operations. The solution was tailored for separating wet and dry components in FOG processing workflows.

recent_news.headline: CDL Driver Shortage Continues to Impact Waste Haulers Despite FMCSA Non-Citizen Rule Implementation
recent_news.summary: An FMCSA rule affecting non-citizen CDL drivers went into effect, with waste haulers like Waste Pro warning of significant business impacts due to the already-critical CDL shortage in the sanitation industry.
